name: a small manual
long: A small manual is lying here.
stats: cure light, cure critic, cure serious

extras.desc:
This manuscript, written in a very neat handwriting, is obviously the work of a
high priest. It discusses the prayers and preperations that seemed to help her
in healing the wounded. It is divided into three parts: "The Curing of Light
Wounds", "The Curing of More Serious Wounds", and "Curing the Critically
Injured".

name: a small leather book
long: A small leather book is lying here.
stats: create food, create water, heroes feast

extras.desc:
This small, tightly bound leather book is titled "Feeding the Faithful" and
includes the prayers and preparations that a high priest uses when she is
conjuring food for her faithful followers. This book has three sections:
"Creation of Food", "Creation of Water", and "A Rewarding Feast".

name: a forest green book
long: A forest green book is lying here.

extras.desc:
This oddly colored book was obviously written by a druid (that probably would
explain the color) and dicusses various trees and such that live in the forest.
One thing that does catch your eye is a chapter about telling which trees are
able to cast spells. Apparently, Eucalyptus trees and the trees that "shiver"
do not cast spells, but the trees that "moan" do.

name: a history manual

extras.desc:

about how the Aborigines and Roos are constantly fighting each other. Though
nobody knows what started the fighting (not even they remember anymore), some
historians believe it has something to do with the death of a Roo princess and
an Aborigine prince.

long: A hide bound book with a large C on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
C. Some of the entries look like these:
The "Cub*" Clan- this group has been know to wander around the world with no
   paticular goal except to just see what it can kill.
Club- very effective in the harvesting of seal fur.

name: an encyclopedia vol. D
long: A hide bound book with a large D on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
D. Some of the entries look like these:
Dracolich- often underrated (at least recently), the dracolich is quite deadly
   to even powerful opponents.
Dice, fuzzy- often seen hanging from the top of various "mounts" these cute
   little things are quite soft and warm.

name: an encyclopedia vol. E
long: A hide bound book with a large A on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
E. Some of the entries look like these:
Enfan- little child-like creatures... so cute you want to kill them on sight!
Energy bow- these rather "strange" bows don't even shoot anything, people can
  only beat others over the head with them. Despite this, they are highly
  sought after.

name: an encyclopedia vol. F
long: A hide bound book with a large F on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
F. Some of the entries look like these:
Friend- though most people claim to be one, you never can seem to find one when
   you need one the most... especially on wednesday nights.
Flaming scorpion- a very potent drink from New Thalos.

name: an encyclopedia vol. G
long: A hide bound book with a large G on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
G. Some of the entries look like these:
Golem- there are so many variaties of golems that it would be impossible to
   name them all... in fact, more are being made today than ever before!
Gold- for some reason, this soft metal has a high value though one would wonder
   why since you can't even make a decent weapon out of it.

name: an encyclopedia vol. H
long: A hide bound book with a large H on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
H. Some of the entries look like these:
Humans- while good in a fight, they just lack the concentration for serious
   study of most other disciplines.
Halberd- if you have the strength for one, a halberd is a fairly sturdy weapon
   with fairly decent damage and medium upkeep.

name: an encyclopedia vol. I
long: A hide bound book with a large I on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
I. Some of the entries look like these:
Ice, Vanilla- an individual with a high opinion of his singing and dancing
   skills who said "Word" to your mother. (personally I'd beat him up)
Ice Boots- these are for people that enjoy getting cold feet (others just seem
   to lose them or something since they disappear after a while).

name: an encyclopedia vol. J
long: A hide bound book with a large J on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
J. Some of the entries look like these:
Jugglernaut- this stupid oaf couldn't juggle two items, let alone the several
   that he tries to toss around. Fortunately, he gets a large allowance that
   goes to replace the items he is constantly dropping.
Jello pudding pop- a truly wonderful invention, life would just not be the same
   without an occasional one of these.

name: an encyclopedia vol. K
long: A hide bound book with a large K on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
K. Some of the entries look like these:
Kanga-Roo, Captain- leader of the Roo forces in their fued against their hated
   enemies, the Aborigines. Fortunately, the Aborigine Chief is just as inept
   or else the war would have ended in defeat for the Roos.
Knife- a very useful invention, the knife helps us in many ways. When one is
   done with a knife, it is also discovered that it fits nicely in someone's
   back. [See "Friend" in vol. F]

name: an encyclopedia vol. L
long: A hide bound book with a large L on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
L. Some of the entries look like these:
Lamia- for some reason, these rather noisy and annoying creatures seem to hang
   out in Old Thalos in large numbers.
Light source- for some reason, these always seem to expire right after you flee
   so you do not have any idea where you are or how to get out.

name: an encyclopedia vol. M
long: A hide bound book with a large M on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
M. Some of the entries look like these:
Mime- these guys must have a serious mental problem! If I ever started acting
   like one of them, I'd pray that someone would kill me!
Musical Instruments- while many types are out there, unfortunately, there are
   just as many people that think that they can use them and couldn't carry
   a tune if it were glued to them and weighed nothing.

name: an encyclopedia vol. N
long: A hide bound book with a large N on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
N. Some of the entries look like these:
Nomad- talk about crazy, these people seem to get some sort of thrill out of
   living in a hot, dry place with little water. At least some carry money.
Nail- useful in construction, these small pieces of metal can also be used to
   nail someone to the wall.

name: an encyclopedia vol. O
long: A hide bound book with a large O on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
O. Some of the entries look like these:
Otyugh- these vile and disgusting creatures live an filth and trash, but why do
   some of them seem to have a more pleasant personality than politicians?
Onyx- another highly valued material, things made of this stuff tend to be
   highly praised until their power is made more realistic.

name: an encyclopedia vol. P
long: A hide bound book with a large P on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
P. Some of the entries look like these:
Purple Worm- this large creature lives in the Desert and is always looking for
   something to snack on. Also quite sociable, he is often known to have even
   univited visitors for lunch.
Pick- a useful tool in digging all of the graves for the people who die a bit
   too often.

name: an encyclopedia vol. Q
long: A hide bound book with a large Q on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
Q. Some of the entries look like these:
Quickling- these annoying little faeries must be on drugs! Nothing normal in
   this world would move as fast as they do if they weren't on speed.
Quickness, Sword of- even if you are not so quick (checked your intelligence
   recently?), this sword will help quicken your speed in combat.

name: an encyclopedia vol. R
long: A hide bound book with a large R on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
R. Some of the entries look like these:
Rat- there are many varieties of rat (flying, sewer, wererat, ...) you will
   also discover that while not all, a few are good eatin' if you cook them
   properly (the radioactive rats are sought by the best chefs).
Rapier- a useful weapon, it can really help get your point across if you get
   in an argument.

name: an encyclopedia vol. S
long: A hide bound book with a large S on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
S. Some of the entries look like these:
Shark- they are waiting for you with big, nasty, pointy teeth. They've got a
   mean streak a mile wide!
Sting- not only a popular weapon, Sting also makes a fairly good living as
   a rock musician.

name: an encyclopedia vol. T
long: A hide bound book with a large T on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
T. Some of the entries look like these:
Tasmanian Devil- a rather nasty and viscious beast, it was captured by several
   Roo soldiers by order of their queen. They had hoped that they could train
   it to kill the Aborigines, but they have had no success. It is currently
   kept in a locked cage for which the queen has the only key.
Two-handed sword- large and heavy, very few people are able to wield it. Those
   that can, however, find it to be a fairly useful and damaging weapon.

name: an encyclopedia vol. U
long: A hide bound book with a large U on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
U. Some of the entries look like these:
Unicorn- these horny horses only go for those that are pure good. Most people,
   however, do not want to admit that these steeds will let them ride.
Ukelele- a kind of small guitar, most serious muscians don't consider this
   instrument a real instrument for entertaining anyone except children.

name: an encyclopedia vol. V
long: A hide bound book with a large V on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter
V. Some of the entries look like these:
Vampire- these bloodsuckers are pure evil and tend to ruin a person's day
   (or night rather) whenever they feel hungry.
Vorpal Sword- a kind of nifty sword, when properly made, these swords can do
   quite a fair amount of damage.

name: an encyclopedia vol. W
long: A hide bound book with a large W on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter

Wolf- these guys are just big puppies gone bad. Now they attack almost anyone

Whip, snake_headed- used by those silly drow priestesses; the larger ones can

   wielder.

name: an encyclopedia vol. X
long: A hide bound book with a large X OBon the side is lying here.

extras.desc:
This book is just packed with creatures and items that begin with the letter

Xenia, the Silver Dragon- quite large and ancient, this dragon hangs out in the

Xylophone- this unusual instrument allows one to fine tune other musical

name: an encyclopedia vol. Y
long: A hide bound book with a large Y on the side is lying here.

extras.desc:

Yellow tulip- for some unknown reason, holding this pretty little flower helps

name: an encyclopedia vol. Z

extras.desc:

extras.desc:
It is finely crafted, and obviously very valuable. It looks like it is
probably very old.

name: a silver chalice
long: A fine chalice of silver sits here in the ground.

extras.desc: It is of fine craftsmanship. There is a small engraving in the base.
To Evistar, may you drink always in safety and good health. -HC

name: the Necklace of Wisdom
long: The Necklace of Wisdom lies on the ground, radiating goodness.

extras.desc:
It is made of an unknown substance, and is smooth to the touch and glassy
in appearance, and yet at the same time is as hard as steel. It is translucent,
allowing you to peer into its depths, without comprehending the mysteries that
are hidden there. It writhes in your hand like a live thing, sending shivers
down your spine.

name: a wooden crate
long: A wooden crate is stacked against the wall.

extras.desc: It is a sturdy-looking wooden crate.

name: some yellow dust
long: There is some yellow dust here; probably the remains of what was once food.

extras.desc:
It looks like it once was probably some kind of foodstuff, but it really
doesn't look very appetizing anymore.

name: a bottle of fine aged whiskey
long: There is a bottle of fine aged whiskey just waiting to be imbibed here.

extras.desc:
Wow! You really lucked out this time. This is an expensive draught, but well
worth the asking price. You smack your lips in anticipation.

name: some very dry, very old iron rations
long: There are some desiccated iron rations sitting here.

extras.desc: They don't really look that appetizing. At least they don't stink.

name: the barrel
long: A barrel has been left here.

extras.desc:
A strong wooden barrel bound with iron hoops. It looks old, but seems to be
sturdy nonetheless.

name: the barrel
long: A barrel has been left here.

extras.desc:
A strong wooden barrel bound with iron hoops. It looks old, but seems to be
sturdy nonetheless.

name: a wooden crate
long: A wooden crate is overturned on the floor here.

extras.desc: It is a sturdy-looking wooden crate, now ripped open.

name: a bar of soap
long: A small bar of soap sits here.

extras.desc:
It has a has a fresh scent. You look like you could use a bath, so go ahead
and have a scrub!

name: the desk
long: sturdy iron bars to the south, and also a strong oaken door to the west.

extras.desc:
It is rather small and austere. It looks like it was made for efficiency,
more than anything else. It has a single droor, which has a big heavy lock
on it. It is firmly bolted to the floor.

name: the grey metal key
long: You notice a key made of a dull grey metal on the ground.

extras.desc: It is unremarkable.

name: a filing cabinet
long: desk, other than that, the room is bare and uninteresting. There is a set of

extras.desc:
It is made of steel, and looks pretty heavy. The lock on it looks quite
servicable, despite its apparent age. It is firmly bolted to the floor.

name: a large steel key
long: A large steel key rests here.

name: drawer
long: The drawer from a filing cabinet has been left here.

extras.desc:
It is made of steel, and is kind of heavy and bulky. It looks like it was
taken out of a filing cabinet or something.

The bones are brittle with age. There is some beat up looking armor clinging
to it, no longer useful in its protective function.

name: a grey potion
long: A potion with a dull grey color sits here.

extras.desc:
The cart has only one wheel remaining on it's single axle. Apparently it was
horse drawn, but there are no signs of the steeds that pulled it.

name: a broken greatsword
long: One half of a broken greatsword lies here on the floor.

name: a pile of broken bones
long: A collection of broken bones from past meals lies here.

extras.desc:
This pile of bones must be several inches deep. They look like fish, mostly,
but you recognize some trogloyte bones in there as well, and something else
humanoid, maybe.

name: a dull grey helmet
long: A dull grey helmet rests here, surveying the room.

extras.desc:
It is a T-cross model, with a drooping grey plume. It looks very old, but
still quite servicable. There are some semi-precious stones set in the crest,
making it worth something as treasure, at the least.
A couple garnets, and a few amythests.

It has a very hard clear material through which you can see the contents.
Efforts to break through it are unfruitful. You wonder where the troglodytes
could have discovered such an item. There is a small hole on the left edge of
the case; ostensibly it is the locking mechanism.

name: a small bone
long: A very small bone rests here, almost unnoticably.

extras.desc: It looks like a finger bone of an unknown creature of some sort.

name: the Ghost Sword
long: A ghostly glowing sword floats just above the floor here.

extras.desc:
It is cool to the touch, and very light. You feel odd holding it, though.
Clearly it was not crafted for mortal hands to wield.

name: the Greatsword
long: There is a Greatsword leaning agaist the wall here. It is as tall as you are.

extras.desc:
This is the largest sword you've ever seen. It dwarfs all other two-handed
swords. There are some silver runes on the black adamantite blade.

extras.desc: It covers the entire wall.

extras.desc: It looks pretty beat up, but remains intact and unopened.

name: a floor cabinet
long: There is a cabinet resting against the wall, locked up tight.

name: a massive wooden bar
long:
A huge wooden bar stands at the western end of the room. Behind it are dusty
glasses and empty bottles that haven't been touched in centuries.

extras.desc:
A massive piece of furniture. It's made out of wood, and takes up the entire
western edge of the room, where it comes three feet of the ground and stands
bolted to the floor a few feet from the west wall. There are a few shelves on
a counter inset into the wall as well, with glasses and empty bottles on them.
They are empty.
They are also made of wood, and firmly attached to the wall.

name: a flat black key
long: There is a black key lying on the ground here, nearly invisible.

extras.desc:
It is a very strange contraption, it folds and bends along many hinges. It
looks like it would fit a complicated lock.

name: a twisted key
long: A key lies on the ground here, twisted and scorched almost beyond recognition.

extras.desc:
It positively pulses with evil. It looks like it was thrown in a blast
furnace, and is partially melted on one side. It is completely black, but
you can't tell if it's from the process that burned it, or whether it was
originally that color.

name: a gigantic oven
long: A oven of truly impressive size abutts the south wall.

extras.desc:
It is warm, as if it was used recently. It is crusty and rusty and made of
iron and very large and bulky. You venture it probably was up to the task of
feeding the residents of this outpost.

name: the stove
long: A gritty black stove takes up the center of the kitchen.

extras.desc: It looks like it was used recently, unlike anything else in this outpost.

name: the heavy steel key
long: A steel key weighs heavily on the ground.

extras.desc: This thing could practically be used as a cudgel!

name: a grey metal key
long: There is a grey metal key lying on the ground.

extras.desc: You see something REALLY special. Not.

name: a U-lock key
long: There is a funny key sitting on its end here.

extras.desc:
The business end looks like a circle with dents in the edge. The cylinder
that this circle is on the end of tapers up into flat circle, so you can hold
it to turn. Just what you would turn with this key totally excapes you - it
would clearly be a lock, but of a kind you have never seen.

name: a reinforced oaken door
long: A reinforced oaken door lies on the ground here, torn from its hinges.

extras.desc:
It has a couple of strong leather straps on the back. If you could carry it,
it would be an incredible shield.

extras.desc: It looks like it has been attacked with an axe.

extras.desc: They have some initials embroidered on the inseam that read RH.
